claim_ceiling: TF-IDF family production-ready at 174k (adversarial gates PASS). Dense embeddings NOT production-ready (adversarial FAIL). v17b label normalization does NOT generalize to 174k. Citation heritage separates citation-based vs text-based modes.
evidence_summary: All 8 TF-IDF reps PASS both adversarial gates (LangDom<0.85, JP>0.5) on exact k-NN stratified subsample. Production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: LangDom=0.4895, JP=0.7265. Citation heritage: 4/8 PASS (citation-based), 4/8 FAIL (text-based); production default AUC=0.7163. v17b label normalization: NEGATIVE — 4/8 reps degrade >10% on zoom_fine, no hierarchy/legal_area improvement. 3-year dense embeddings (2000-2002, 12.5k): ALL FAIL adversarial (LangDom~0.997, JP~0.005). Two-mode tradeoff confirmed. No leakage, no benchmark gaming, negative results preserved.
